fieldNotes.truckGate: No controlled truck gate. The truck driveway leaves Baseline Rd on the NE corner of the property as a wide open paved drive and curves south into the truck court between the PFG building (west) and a neighboring industrial building (east). Street View (Apr 2024) of the entrance shows no barrier arm, no sliding/swing gate, and no checkpoint pinch-point — only a red 'SHIPPING / RECEIVING' sign at the driveway mouth. No perimeter security fence along Baseline Rd.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth at the entrance or anywhere on the property. The entrance Street View shows an open landscaped driveway with no gatehouse structure.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False — there is no truck gate at all, so remote check-in does not apply.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock doors run along the east (truck-court) face of the long PFG building; tight z20 imagery shows trailers backed into a gravel/dirt dock apron. Corroborating web research (Fox River Foods / PFG-Chicago) reports 23 refrigerated + 11 dry = 34 dock doors total; band 25-50.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Modest trailer parking — roughly a dozen trailers staged in the truck court near the entrance and along the dock apron. The very large dense trailer field immediately EAST of the PFG property belongs to a separate neighboring operation (building-products / general industrial) and is excluded. Band 10-25 for PFG's own staging; capacity estimate low-confidence.
fieldNotes.dropYard: False — no dedicated standalone trailer-storage lot on the PFG parcel; trailers stage in the active truck court only.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: The wide paved truck court at the NE end of the building between the entrance and the dock apron provides interior holding/queue room.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The entrance drive plus the long truck court running the length of the dock face can hold a queue of 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Montgomery IL is a far-southwest Chicago-metro exurb; the site sits in a continuous industrial corridor along Baseline Rd with abutting warehouses and lumber/building-products yards. Classified Urban as part of the greater Chicago metro fabric.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale or weigh platform visible in overhead imagery.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Single long PFG distribution building (~325,000 sq ft per web research). Adjacent large buildings to the east are separate ownership/operations.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur runs into the PFG parcel.
